rules.statement: A scale weight reading must be a non-negative number of kilograms.
rules.subject: scale reading weight

rules.statement: Only the owner of a hive may link a scale to that hive.
rules.subject: scale linking member

rules.statement: A scale that another member has already linked cannot be linked by a different member.
rules.subject: scale ownership

evidence.quote: if (drop <= SWARM_DROP_KG) return { accepted: true, swarmSuspected: false };

rules.statement: A swarm is suspected only when the hive's weight drops by more than the swarm drop threshold, compared with the highest reading in the recent swarm window.
rules.subject: hive weight drop

evidence.quote: return at >= dropAt - INSPECTION_BEFORE_MS && at <= until;

rules.statement: A weight drop is not treated as a swarm if the hive was inspected within the inspection window around the drop (from a set time before it to a set time after it).
rules.subject: inspection time relative to weight drop

rules.statement: No new swarm alert is sent for a scale if it already sent one within the swarm window, or if an alert for it is still pending.
rules.subject: time since last swarm alert

rules.statement: A pending swarm SMS is cancelled when an inspection of the same hive is recorded within the inspection window around the drop.
rules.subject: inspection time relative to pending swarm alert
